eps.t: The Crew Builds a Vet Clinic
eps.o: When the traveling veterinarian Dr. Diwa can't finish all her checkups in Builder Cove in time, Rubble and Crew know what to do.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Mermaid Party
eps.o: Lily's mermaid-themed birthday party is called off when it starts to rain; time for a construction solution!

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Sea Wall
eps.o: Park Ranger Rose asks Rubble and crew to fix the bridge to Bear Island; but when Speed Meister intervenes, the pups must clean up his mess and protect the bears from a rapidly approaching storm with help from Auntie Crane's new Bark Yard Zoomer!

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Hotel Elevator
eps.o: Rubble and Crew helps at Hotel Hadley after snow and when stairs fail, it's bow wow time.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Popcorn-Cat Café
eps.o: Café Carl adopted kittens! But when they cause popcorn pandemonium, Rubble & Crew make the café cat-friendly.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Super Mega Movie Screen
eps.o: A new Super Squirrelly Whirly movie is playing at the drive-in theater! But when Speed Meister gets in the way, the pups spring into action to save the day.

eps.t: The Crew Builds an Auntie Day Present
eps.o: It's Auntie Day! But can the pups finish building their present for Auntie Crane in time?

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Giant Skate Track
eps.o: Rubble and crew help River take lots of pictures for the big photo contest by building a super-fast way to get around Builder Cove.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Giant Ice Cream Maker
eps.o: Rubble and the pups help Café Carl make enough ice cream for everyone! If Speed Meister doesn't get in the way....

Rubble and crew are building their biggest construction project ever, a skyscraper; and a job that huge calls for brand-new, mega-sized construction vehicles; but when Speed Meister sees the pups' big trucks, he calls in help from his big brother.

eps.t: The Crew Lifts Up City Hall
eps.o: A herd of bison are migrating through Builder Cove-right toward City Hall.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Rotating Restaurant
eps.o: Rubble and crew hop in their big vehicles to save the day; the pups use their mega-sized trucks to help Lucas and Lily give their parents an awesome anniversary.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Giant Tunnel
eps.o: Park Ranger Rose and the crew discover a meteorite outside of Builder Cove; when Speed Meister and Mega Meister try to take it, the pups need their construction vehicles to save the town and get the meteorite to the Science Centre.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Mega Stunt Ramp
eps.o: The crew uses their trucks to make stunt ramps when Mega Meister challenges Mayor Greatway to a stunt competition.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Solar Farm
eps.o: When power problems shut down Sierra Sparkle's show, the pups hop in their big vehicles to turn the power back on.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Giant Turtle House
eps.o: It's Friend Appreciation Day; but when Speed Meister's gift for Mr. McTurtle goes awry, he has to call Rubble and crew for help.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Giant Volcano
eps.o: Rubble and Crew helps Lucas make the Science Fair volcano; but will Wingsy get in the way of the eruption?

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Firefighter Training Center
eps.o: A new fire captain helps train the pups as firefighter recruits at the fire station.

eps.t: The Crew Builds a Sierra Sparkle Space Show
eps.o: Charger is excited to help Sierra Sparkle with her big show, but a hurt paw stops him.
